tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the Tide Line navy, one step off the roundel's outer ring (#032f49) so the mark still reads. Daylight is for /my/ and /admin/ when the phone is in light mode or the sun toggle is on.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Form groups, admin cards, the sticky CTA bar, table rows on phones. The public site mostly uses hairlines instead.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: One step above panel: input fills, selected rows, the follow-up box in the medical form.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on bg, panel and panel-raised. ≥11:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on bg and panel. Always underlined in body copy.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, captions, cert codes on bg, panel, panel-raised. ≥6.4:1 dark, ≥5.5:1 daylight.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: The action colour: primary buttons, links, active states, meter fill, the italic accent line. Daylight swaps to the logo's deep blue because aqua text on light panels fails AA. Text on a filled aqua is on-aqua.

tokens.name: on-aqua
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an aqua fill. 9.4:1 dark, 7.5:1 daylight.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the rules between menu rows, table rows, section breaks. Decorative only (below 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, checkboxes, radios, yes/no, outline buttons, upload zones. ≥3:1 on bg, panel and panel-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset, on every interactive element. Dark is the logo's light-shaft colour.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done / signed / paid text and icons. Always paired with a check icon and a word. On bg, panel, ok-bg.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok badges and the done state of a checklist item.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention: physician required, expiring soon, minor without guardian. Always with an icon and a word. On bg, panel, warn-bg.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind warn badges and warning alerts.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Missing / expired / error. Coral against the teal ok so the pair splits on the blue–orange axis. Always with an icon and a word. On bg, panel, danger-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger badges, error alerts, invalid input backgrounds.

tokens.name: signature-paper
tokens.usage: The signature canvas, white in both themes on purpose (the brief's intentional contrast).

tokens.name: signature-ink
tokens.usage: The drawn stroke and the baseline label on signature-paper.

tokens.name: logo-abyss
tokens.usage: Logo flat: the roundel's outer navy. Illustration, cover and hero only — never text. Only 1.23:1 against bg, so the roundel's edge dissolves into the dark page; keep it on bg deliberately or give it breathing room.

tokens.name: logo-deep
tokens.usage: Logo flat: deepest cave wall. Doubles as daylight aqua.

tokens.name: logo-mid
tokens.usage: Logo flat: mid cave wall. Doubles as daylight focus.

tokens.name: logo-current
tokens.usage: Logo flat: the water column. Illustration only.

tokens.name: logo-swoosh
tokens.usage: Logo flat: the wave swoosh. The Tide rules beside DIVING, wave dividers, the rule under section eyebrows. 6.4:1 on bg, but use it for marks and rules, not text.

tokens.name: logo-cenote
tokens.usage: Logo flat: the brightest water. Illustration and hero gradients only.

tokens.name: logo-shaft
tokens.usage: Logo flat: the light shaft. Hero light-beam gradients, dark focus ring.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Public hero headline only, Georgia. Spanish runs longer: size for “Tu próxima inmersión.” Drops to 34/38 below 360px.

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: The italic second line of the hero, in aqua. One per page.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Section titles on the public page, screen titles in /my/ (Georgia).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Menu-row names (cenotes, courses), card titles, the diver's name.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Form group titles, checklist item titles, admin card titles. Sans, never serif.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tell us your experience level and preferred dates.
styles.usage: All running text and every input. 16px minimum so iOS never zooms.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Hints, secondary lines, table cells on phones.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Spaced caps above section titles, in muted. Uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text at small size, badge words.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices on the public menu rows (Georgia's old-style figures). Right-aligned after a dotted leader.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dates, IDs and credential numbers in admin tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside chips, between label and input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone gutter (the brief's 16px), card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards, between form groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on phone.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section breaks on desktop; minimum touch target height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, checkboxes (6px box).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Alerts, the follow-up box, admin table rows on phones.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Admin and diver-area cards, the signature box.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, the sticky bar buttons, status pills, the language switch.

tokens.name: shadow-bar
tokens.usage: The sticky bottom CTA bar only. Everything else separates with line, not shadow.
